scope: Saved weights and rollout summaries only; no new rollouts or training
limitations: Saved rollout records lack per-decision probabilities, candidate counts, observations and baseline predictions; exact normalized entropy, probability drift and empirical value MSE are not recoverable.
Mean entropy and mean candidate counts alone do not establish proximity to uniform: log(mean count) differs from mean(log count).
The value bounds follow from tanh hidden activations in [-1,1] and the saved value weights; underfit scale is verified, causal impact on policy improvement is only a hypothesis.
